description: Energy consumption by sector and local authority is a dataset listed in Westofenglandca open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. Subnational energy consumption data for the South West of England. Coverage: West of England Combined Authority area. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are Energy, fuel, Environment, emissions. The portal shows 11,286 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL v.3 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-westofengland-ca-gov-uk-portal.
